security_audit.summary: All ten static detections are false positives involving Markdown, attribution links, or protective discussion of private keys. The guide mischaracterizes URL-based external signing as air-gapped, without demonstrating offline isolation. No evidence found of executable payloads, credential collection, exfiltration, or prompt injection in the reviewed file.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md describes a URL-based external signer as air-gapped without establishing offline isolation.
remediation.suggestion: Use the term external signing unless an offline transfer boundary exists. Document signer authentication, transport protection, authorization, and deployment assumptions.

remediation.issue: The public guide claims enforced limits and immutable logging, but the implementation is explicitly absent.
remediation.suggestion: Label runtime results as illustrative. Explain that financial enforcement and log integrity require separate implementation and verification before handling funds.

semantic_findings.title: Networked Signing Mischaracterized As Air-Gapped
semantic_findings.description: The guide calls URL-based external signing "Air-Gapped Signing" and claims isolation through a dedicated URL. External key custody alone does not establish an offline boundary; this wording can lead users to overestimate protection when deploying wallets.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both passages explicitly equate a signer URL with air-gapped isolation. No offline transfer mechanism is documented; this confirms misleading guidance, not an observed signer compromise.

content.user_title: Plan Spending Controls for Agent Wallets
content.value_statement: Autonomous agents need spending limits and clear approval rules before handling funds. This public guide outlines wallet controls for planning, but does not include implementation files.
actual_capabilities: Describe per-transaction, daily, and lifetime spending limits.
Outline domain allowlists, denylists, and approval thresholds.
Explain external signer configuration through WALLET_SIGNER_URL.
Describe approval queues and append-only payment audit logs.
Illustrate a $50 daily cap with approval required above $10.
Document external signer, local storage, and single-currency constraints.
limitations: Only the public guide is included; scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.
A separate external signer is required; URL-based signing alone does not establish air-gapped isolation.
The described local queues and logs are not natively distributed, and currency conversion is not built in.
Spending enforcement and immutable logging cannot be verified from the supplied documentation.

use_cases.title: Specify Agent Spending Policies
use_cases.description: Draft daily budgets and approval thresholds before integrating an agent with a separately implemented wallet service.

use_cases.title: Review Wallet Custody Boundaries
use_cases.description: Identify signer isolation assumptions and distinguish documented controls from protections that require implementation evidence.

use_cases.title: Define Payment Approval Requirements
use_cases.description: Plan which payments require human review and which events should appear in the payment audit trail.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the documented wallet controls and identify which implementation files are absent. Do not claim that any controls are active.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Budget Policy
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a plain-language policy with a $50 daily cap and approval above $10. Mark it as a proposal, not an installed configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Approval and Audit Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Outline approval and audit requirements for high-value payments using this guide. Identify limitations of local queues and single-currency policies.

prompt_templates.title: Review Signer Security Assumptions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the external signer claims. Explain why a signer URL does not prove air-gapped isolation. List implementation evidence needed before using real funds.

output_examples.input: Propose a $50 daily cap and require approval above $10.
output: Proposed approval rule: payments above $10 require human approval.
Status: planning only; no wallet configuration or transaction was executed.

output_examples.input: Can this folder enforce wallet limits without other components?
output: No. This folder contains a public guide, not the policy engine or integration templates.
A separate signer and a verified implementation are required.
The described local queues are not distributed, and the policy assumes one currency.

output_examples.input: Does WALLET_SIGNER_URL mean the signer is air-gapped?
output_examples.output: No. A signer URL identifies an external service. It does not prove offline isolation, authenticated access, or enforced spending controls.

best_practices: Keep private keys outside agent prompts and environments; verify the separately deployed signer before connecting funds.
Treat guide examples as proposals until a tested implementation enforces spending limits and approvals.
Verify signer authorization and audit integrity independently before relying on the documented security claims.
anti_patterns: Assuming the documentation alone installs or enforces wallet controls.
Treating a remote signer URL as proof of air-gapped isolation.
Treating an append-only local log as tamper-proof without independently verified protections.

faq.question: Does this skill include a working wallet implementation?
faq.answer: No. The supplied folder contains only the public guide. Scripts, extension source, and templates from the original package are absent.

faq.question: Which spending controls does the guide describe?
faq.answer: It describes per-transaction, daily, and lifetime caps, domain restrictions, and human approval thresholds. Their enforcement is not verifiable here.

faq.question: Do I need to share private keys with the agent?
faq.answer: The guide recommends keeping private keys outside the agent environment and using a separate signer. Do not place keys in prompts.

faq.question: Is URL-based external signing necessarily air-gapped?
faq.answer: No. A URL does not establish offline isolation. The actual deployment requires an independent security assessment.

faq.question: Which agents does the guide target?
faq.answer: The guide targets OpenClaw and local Python agents. Integration code is absent, so runtime compatibility cannot be verified.

faq.question: What storage and currency limitations are documented?
faq.answer: The described logs and queues use local files and are not natively distributed. Policies assume one currency without built-in conversion.
